title: STM32 sensor hub with a Linux IIO driver
summary: A small but realistic embedded system where the STM32 handles time-sensitive sensor work and the Raspberry Pi handles Linux-side integration, buffering, and user access.
highlights: Pipeline: sensors, STM32 NUCLEO-F446RE, UART or SPI link (interface still to be chosen), Raspberry Pi 4, custom Linux kernel driver, Linux IIO subsystem, userspace tools and data logging.
Hardware on the bench: breadboard, jumper wires, resistors for pull-ups, dividers and protection, buttons for GPIO and user-control experiments, status and debug LEDs.
Status: in progress. Results will be added when the project is complete.
